title: Inhabitation and selection of margin-retaining exchange-stable Ds states
statement: REROUTED by DS17 (30-31 Aug 2026). (a) INHABITATION on the DS15/DS16 class: RESOLVED NEGATIVELY - DS-STABLE-BASINS-CENTERED-OBSTRUCTION proves that on every atomless (L)-law with (M1)+(M4) (neither (S) nor (R) needed), almost surely, eventually NO one-point exchange-stable labeling satisfies (M2)+(M3)+(M5) at any fixed margins: the DS14 hypothesis set is asymptotically empty, and free-ascent funnel measurements were the finite face of this theorem, not a seeding artifact. What remains open here: (a') the (M5)-free merged branch - can exchange-stable empirical sequences track sign-split-type wasted-cell configurations (ties are knife-edge; DS-STABLE-BASINS-LCM-CLASSIFICATION gives the population family, value pinned at v_2 in every scanned instance), and does anything useful survive given that their compilable reductions have lambda_min = 0; (a'') attainment and one-sided continuity of v*(kappa)/v*+(kappa), whose feasible class {lambda_min(I_q) >= kappa} DS17.3(4) proves NONEMPTY for kappa <= 1/pi on the canonical law. (b) SELECTION: subsumed - DS16's funnel plus DS17's emptiness make terminal degeneracy on the class unconditional eventually; no seeding question remains on-class. (c) DESIGN: a margin-constrained exchange method on the class terminates only at constrained-stable states (ordinary-stable certified terminals eventually do not exist); design and gap reporting move to OP7 under the DS17 constraints. The live inhabitation/transfer question moves OFF the class to OP29 branch (a) (OPEN-DS-MARGINS-NONCENTERED), gated per law by DS-STABLE-BASINS-FIXED-POINT-GATE: mix3's root is the efficient optimum itself with lambda_min = 1.7364 at price ~ 0, and the empirical transfer from a root's basin to exact one-point stability (boundary noise vs O(1/N) move gains) is the isolated open condition.
